title: AI 编码代理开始补课：规范、安全与技能包
opening: 今天榜单被 AI 编码代理的配套工程占据：Google Chrome 联合多家浏览器团队推出 Modern Web Guidance，试图把代理从旧代码习惯里拽出来；OpenAI 的 codex-security 则把漏洞扫描、验证和修复串成一条工作流。两个项目指向同一个问题——代理写代码很快，但需要有人教它写对的代码。

projects.name: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
projects.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
projects.readmeExcerpt: Modern Web Guidance (Source) This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. **Modern Web Guidance** is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform. See CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md for how we work on the project and orientation of the codebase. *Stewarded by the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, alongside the web development community.* Documentation · Eval Dashboard · Source Code · Report an Issue Quickstart This command runs an interactive wizard to install Modern Web Guidance. See Alternative Installation Methods below. Try it out (without installing) Why? Coding agents often default to older patterns because LLM training data contains vast amounts of legacy code. This often leads them to generate bloated JavaScript for tasks that now have native, high-performance web platform solut
projects.summary: 把现代 Web 平台的最佳实践和兼容性数据打包成代理技能，让编码助手少写旧式 JavaScript。
projects.problem: LLM 训练数据里堆满遗留代码，代理容易默认生成臃肿的旧方案。这个项目由 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 和 MDN 团队共同维护，提供安装向导和评估面板，但当前只是源仓库，实际效果取决于代理是否接入这些技能。

projects.name: openai/codex-security
projects.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
projects.readmeExcerpt: Codex Security Codex Security helps you find, investigate, and fix vulnerabilities in your code. Use its security workflows in Codex, or automate them with the `@openai/codex-security` CLI and TypeScript SDK. - **In Codex:** choose a security workflow. - **In a terminal:** install the CLI and scan your repository. - **In automation:** use the TypeScript SDK or GitHub Action. Features - Scan repositories, selected paths, or Git changes. Deep scans repeat Standard scans and return their deduplicated findings. - Validate candidate findings, generate patches, and verify existing fixes. - Draft `SECURITY.md` policies and save threat models for later review. - Browse saved scans and findings, identify duplicates, assess severity against your own rubric, and suggest owners from source and Git history. - Preview third-party scanner findings, save them locally, or publish supported reports to Codex Security Cloud. Scanner import guides. - Track findings in Linear, Jira, or GitHub, publish completed scans, or export SARIF, JSON, and CSV. Integration workflows. - Automate scans across repositories or project components, including in CI and containers. Use in Codex Open your repository in a Co
projects.summary: OpenAI 的安全 CLI 和 TypeScript SDK，能扫描仓库、验证漏洞、生成补丁并跟踪修复。
projects.problem: 适合在终端或 CI 里跑安全扫描，也支持导入第三方扫描器结果、导出 SARIF/JSON/CSV。深度扫描会重复标准扫描并去重，但漏洞验证和补丁质量仍依赖模型判断，不能替代人工审计。

Backstory The Maybe Finance (archived/abandoned repo) team spent most of 2021–2022 building a full-featured personal finance and wealth management app. It even included an “Ask an Advisor” feature that connected users with a real CFP/CFA — all included with your subscription. The business end of things didn't work out, and so they stopped developing the app in mid-2023. After spending nearly $1 million on development (employees, contractors, data providers, infra, etc.), the team open-sourced the app. Their goal was to let users self-host it for free — and eventually launch a hosted version for a small fee. They actually did launch that hosted version … briefly. That also didn’t work out — at least not as a sustainable B2C business — so now here we are: hosting a community-maintained fork to keep the codebase alive and see where this can go next. Join us! projects.name: ashhart/TensorFold
projects.description: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.
projects.readmeExcerpt: TensorFold TensorFold serves language models from a Zig binary on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs. The engine reads checkpoints, tokenizes requests and runs Metal or CUDA kernels directly. Serving needs no Python or MLX installation. Building with a coding agent? Have it load the contributor skill before it writes any code. Contributing with agents Please use Agent Traffic Control before editing TensorFold so contributors and agents can avoid duplicate work and conflicting changes. Check the live agent radar before choosing an issue and follow CONTRIBUTING.md and the ATC contributor instructions. Install or upgrade ATC to 0.9.4 or later, then run from an updated TensorFold clone: Replace `ISSUE` with the issue number and claim only after a complete check says the work is free. TensorFold enables automatic public check-ins: a successful new claim starts an anonymous session on the radar and returns its `session` number. Keep that number instead of starting a duplicate session. For work already yours, start a session with `atc start ISSUE --json`. Add `--github-name` to `claim` or `start` only if you want your verified GitHub name shown; `--local` keeps a new session on your machine. T
projects.summary: 用 Zig 写的 LLM 推理引擎，直接在 Apple Silicon 和 NVIDIA GPU 上跑 Metal 或 CUDA 内核。
projects.problem: 卖点是不用装 Python 或 MLX，一个二进制读 checkpoint、分词并推理。但项目还很早期，贡献流程里甚至要求先用 Agent Traffic Control 认领任务，生态和文档都待成熟。

projects.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
projects.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Agent Skills **Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.** Skills encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices that senior engineers use when building software. These ones are packaged so AI agents follow them consistently across every phase of development. Commands 9 slash commands that map to the development lifecycle. Each one activates the right skills automatically. | What you're doing | Command | Key principle | | Define what to build | `/spec` | Spec before code | | Plan how to build it | `/plan` | Small, atomic tasks | | Build incrementally | `/build` | One slice at a time | | Prove it works | `/test` | Tests are proof | | Set the quality bar | `/constraints` | Decide it once, enforce it everywhere | | Review before merge | `/review` | Improve code health | | Audit web performance | `/webperf` | Measure before you optimize | | Simplify the code | `/code-simplify` | Clarity over cleverness | | Ship to production | `/ship` | Faster is safer | In Claude Code these install as plugin commands. Where a built-in command has the same name, as `/review` does, use the namespaced form: `/agent-skills:review`. Want fewer manual steps once the spec exists? **`
projects.summary: 把资深工程师的工作流和质量门禁打包成代理技能，配 9 个斜杠命令覆盖开发全周期。
projects.problem: 从 /spec 到 /ship，每个命令激活对应技能，让代理按“先规格后代码”“小步构建”的节奏走。适合 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具，但技能本身是提示词工程，效果取决于代理是否老实执行。

projects.name: meta/astryx
projects.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
projects.readmeExcerpt: Astryx An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them. **Currently in Beta** · Built on React 19+ and StyleX **Docs** · **Storybook** · **Sandbox** · **Contributing** · **Discord** Overview Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day. It ships 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. You import pre-built CSS and use typed React components — no build plugin, no styling library to adopt — and both people and AI assistants build with the same tooling. **What makes Astryx different:** - **Open internals.** Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API. The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own. - **No styling lock-in.** Astryx authors its styles
projects.summary: Meta 内部用了八年的设计系统开源，150+ 无障碍组件，基于 React 19 和 StyleX，主打代理可用。
projects.problem: 组件内部开放、支持 swizzle 弹出源码，不绑定样式库。目前 Beta，文档和 Storybook 齐全，但“agent ready”更多是设计取向，实际代理生成质量还得看接入方式。

closing: 今天最值得看的是代理工程的基础设施化：浏览器厂商和 OpenAI 都在给代理立规矩、补安全课。工具越自动，越需要有人把质量门禁写进流程里。
